data.long_meaning: The one who reads or recites the Quran
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who is close to Allah, who reads and recites the Quran with devotion and understanding, seeking guidance and closeness to Allah.

in_arabic.name: يسين
in_arabic.meaning: يسين اسم سورة في القرآن الكريم، يعني الحبيب أو الحميم
in_arabic.long_meaning: يسين هو اسم سورة في القرآن الكريم، ويعتبر من أسماء النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، يعني الحبيب أو الحميم، وورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة يس، وهي السورة 36 في ترتيب سور القرآن الكريم، ويحمل هذا الاسم قيمة روحية عالية في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: یسین
in_urdu.meaning: یسین سورہ قرآن میں، مطلب ہے پیارا یا عزیز
in_urdu.long_meaning: یسین قرآن کے سورہ کا نام ہے، اور یہ رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پیارا یا عزیز، یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں بڑی روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان

in_hindi.name: यासीन
in_hindi.meaning: यासीन कुरआन का एक सूरा है, मतलब है प्रिय या घनिष्ठ
in_hindi.long_meaning: यासीन कुरआन का 36वां सूरा है, जिसे मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व दिया जाता है, यह नाम प्रिय या घनिष्ठ को दर्शाता है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम परंपरा में इसकी विशेष आध्यात्मिक महत्ता है

in_pashto.name: یاسین
in_pashto.meaning: یاسین د قرآن سورت نوم، معنی یې د خوږ یا نږدې
in_pashto.long_meaning: یاسین د قرآن کریم د سورتونو څخه د 36 شمېرې سورت دی، چې په اسلامي دود کې یې ډېره روحانيه ارزښت لري، په ځانګړي ډول د افغان او پښتنو ټولنو کې، دا نوم د خوږ یا نږدې معنی لري

in_english.name: Yassin
in_english.meaning: Yassin means beloved or intimate, a Quranic name
in_english.long_meaning: Yassin is derived from Arabic roots, signifying beloved or intimate, it is the title of the 36th chapter of the Quran, holds significant spiritual value in Islam, symbolizing divine love and closeness, historically and culturally important across Muslim communities globally

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل یاسین (ya-SEEN)
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل یاسین (ya-SEEN)

data.cultural_impact: The name Yassin holds great significance in Islamic culture as it is associated with one who has dedicated their life to the study and recitation of the Quran. The name reflects the importance of literacy and education in Islamic tradition, and highlights the role of the Quran as a spiritual and moral guide for Muslims. The name Yassin is also a reminder of the importance of preserving and transmitting the sacred text, which has been passed down orally and through written copies for centuries. In some Islamic communities, individuals known as Hafiz or Hafiza, who have memorized the entire Quran, may be given the name Yassin as a mark of respect and recognition for their dedication and commitment.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Yassin holds deep spiritual significance for Muslims, as it is a reminder of the importance of connecting with Allah through the study and recitation of the Quran. The name represents a deep understanding and commitment to the Islamic faith, and a dedication to living a life in accordance with the teachings of the Quran. The name Yassin can also be seen as a reflection of the belief that the Quran is a source of guidance and wisdom, and a constant reminder of God's presence and love. Ultimately, the name Yassin represents a desire to deepen one's spiritual connection with Allah and strive to live a life in accordance with His will.
